pass_rule: Every ACTIVE page in the exact manifest revision has a non-empty verifiable fingerprint tied to that exact asset_id+asset_revision+asset_ref.
user_rule: The user is never required to calculate SHA-256 manually. Hashing is automatic when bytes are readable; otherwise use a stable platform/Git identity if available.
recovery_rule: After verifiable identity becomes available, create/update the current manifest revision according to normal immutable revision rules, then R01 may clear the block and route only the affected downstream checks.
